text:
alyssa: CI alert: several DAST jobs and SAST backfills failing to decrypt archived evidence after the infra group tidy. Tests show a PermissionDenied from KMS. anyone seen this?

conor: yup, I spotted 403s in build output. service account used by scanners lost decrypt permission when we collapsed nested groups.

sec-bot: job:dast-559 -> ERROR PermissionDenied: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/evidence-key: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:scanners@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

eva: I deployed a small IAM refactor yesterday to remove redundant groups (PR#4120). I didn't touch the keystore binding directly but maybe the group resolution changed.

alyssa: exact log snippet:
```
ERROR 403: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:scanners@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
resource: projects/rdw-prod/.../cryptoKeys/evidence-key
```

sec-oncall: spinning up incident channel #inc-361234-keystore-gap. Immediate mitigation: grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to scanners SA, re-run failing scans and backfill evidence decrypts.

conor: temporary grant command:
```
PROJECT=rdw-prod
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding evidence-key \
  --location=global --keyring=keystore \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanners@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --project=$PROJECT
```

infra-logs: audit hit: ts=3612345720 actor=infra-bot@redwood-inference altered group membership that resolved away scanners SA from keystore binding. Log ref: projects/rdw-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/entries/zxy987. Current audit retention 30d.

sec-oncall: root cause = automated group collapse removed effective membership. Action items: emergency RBAC undo (done), kick off backfill + triage (alyssa/eva), add presubmit check that verifies scanner SAs retain decrypt on keystore keys (conor), create alert on KMS IAM mutations and extend keystore audit retention to 90d (infra/security), update SDLC checklist to require KMS access verification for infra group PRs (alyssa).

alyssa: adding a short test to the infra CI that resolves group membership and attempts a dry-run decrypt against a non-production key. will open PR.

eva: I'll inventory all scanner and evidence-related SAs and add them to a protected binding with explicit members to avoid group resolution surprises.

sec-oncall: Triage note: label any findings surfaced during the window 3612345600-3612345720 as "stale-recheck" until owners re-validate severity. Postmortem + RFC to follow. :white_check_mark:
